claim.claim-text: 1. A pistonless combustor (100) comprising at least one input channel (33, 34, 43, 44, 63) for air and fuel, an output channel (15), and a first combustion chamber (10), wherein said at least one input channel is controlled with a valve (31, 32, 41, 42, 61), characterized in that one or more of the at least one input channel has an eccentric alignment configured to produce an eccentric input flow of air creating a self-preserving flow pattern (91, 92) of a fuel-air mixture within the first combustion chamber (10).

2. A pistonless combustor (100) according to claim 1, wherein said self-preserving flow pattern comprises a first flow component (91) and a second flow component (92) in a nonparallel angle in relation to the first flow component (91) for increasing speed of combustion propagation.

3. A pistonless combustor (100) according to claim 1 or 2, wherein said eccentric input flow has a ratio e/r of at least 0,1 and at most 0,3, where e is a distance (51, 52) between a centre of the first combustion chamber (10) and a line of alignment of the one or more of the at least one input channel (33, 34, 43, 44, 63), and where r is a distance (53) between the centre of the first combustion chamber and an inner surface of an exterior wall of the first combustion chamber.

4. A pistonless combustor (100) according to claim 2 or 3, wherein geometry of the first combustion chamber (10) facilitates maintaining of the first flow component and the second flow component by means of the first combustion chamber having an internal shape that is substantially one of the following: toroidal, spherical and cylindrical.
5. A pistonless combustor (100) according to any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein output channel (15) is constantly open to the first combustion chamber (10).
6. A pistonless combustor (100) according to any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the pistonless combustor is a deflagration combustor.

7. A pistonless combustor (100) according to any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the pistonless combustor further comprises an air channel (43, 44) controlled by an air valve (41, 42) and having an eccentric alignment, the air channel being configured to supply air or fuel-air mixture into the first combustion chamber (10) for maintaining the first flow component (91) and the second flow component (92)within the first combustion chamber (10).

8. A pistonless combustor (100) according to any one of claims 1 to 7, wherein fuel is mixed with air within one or more of the at least one input channel (33, 34, 43, 44, 63) to produce a fuel-air mixture.

9. A pistonless combustor (100) according to any one of claims 1 to 8, wherein the pistonless combustor comprises a pre-combustion chamber (12) having smaller volume than the first combustion chamber (10), wherein the pre-combustion chamber (12) forms a cavity on the periphery of the first combustion chamber (10).
10. A pistonless combustor (100) according to claim 9, wherein the volume of the pre-combustion chamber (12) is at most 10 % of the volume of the first combustion chamber (10).

11. A pistonless combustor (100) according to claim 9, wherein the pre-combustion chamber (12) has a semi-open configuration in which there is a line of sight to each point in an inner wall of the pre-combustion chamber (12) from an opening connecting the pre-combustion chamber (12) to the first combustion chamber (10).

12. A pistonless combustor (100) according to any one of claims 1 to 11, wherein a passage (14) connects the first combustion chamber (10) to a second combustion chamber (11) and the second combustion *chamber (11) is connected to the output channel (15).

13. A pistonless combustor (100) according to any one of claims 1 to 12, wherein the second combustion chamber (11) has a volume larger than a quarter of the volume of the first combustion chamber (10) but smaller than three times the volume of the first combustion chamber (10).
14. A pistonless combustor (100) according to any one of claims 1 to 11, wherein the output channel (15) connects the first combustion chamber to a pressure wave charger.

15. A pistonless combustor (100) according to any one of claims 1 to 14, wherein the pistonless combustor comprises at least one air input channel (43, 44) configured to input air jets having initial air velocity at least Mach 0,2.
